appraisal_events.evidence: je ne parvenais pas à en recueillir une seule ... elle passa au rabot d'une mélopée uniforme toute la tirade où se trouvèrent confondues ensemble des oppositions, pourtant si tranchées, qu'une tragédienne à peine intelligente, même des élèves de lycée, n'en eussent pas négligé l'effet
appraisal_events.explanation: Straining to find any distinctive quality in Berma's diction, the narrator instead finds her flattening a scene's obvious contrasts into a uniform monotone, judging her locally inferior in expressiveness even to lesser talents and to her own supporting cast.

appraisal_events.evidence: Enfin éclata mon premier sentiment d'admiration : il fut provoqué par les applaudissements frénétiques des spectateurs... le moment où se déchaîna cet enthousiasme du public fut, je l'ai su depuis, celui où la Berma a une de ses plus belles trouvailles.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's admiration is finally kindled only by the audience's contagious applause rather than by his own independent perception, and he flags such crowd enthusiasm as generally unreliable; yet the passage confirms this particular outburst coincided with one of Berma's genuinely finest inventions, so the elevation lands despite its suspect mechanism.

status_effects.explanation: Her performance initially fails to yield any of the admired qualities the narrator anticipated, locally lowering his estimate of her relative to expectation and to her co-stars.

The passage culminates in genuine admiration, retrospectively confirmed as one of her finest moments, decisively raising her local standing despite the questionable route (crowd contagion) by which that admiration was reached.

ambiguities: The narrator's admiration for la Berma in the closing movement is triggered by contagious crowd applause that he himself calls generally unreliable ('les applaudissements tombaient le plus souvent à faux'), yet the passage later validates this specific instance as one of her finest moments; the narrative stance toward this elevation is therefore layered rather than straightforwardly endorsed.
